glosses: initial (first letter of a word, of a name, of a first name)
initial, onset (first consonantal phoneme in a syllable. Often used in the study of Chinese languages)

examples.text: Mes initiales sont sur ma valise.
examples.en: My initials are on my briefcase.

examples.text: Le couple a gravé ses initiales sur le chêne.
examples.en: The couple carved their initials into the oak tree.

examples.text: Tom a gravé ses initiales dans le grand chêne devant l'école.
examples.en: Tom carved his initials on the large oak tree in front of the school.
